presentationProfile.title: HRider
presentationProfile.description: HRider helps teams manage performance reviews, 360-degree feedback, and people analytics

changePassword.description: Change the password for an administrator.

createAdministrator.description: Create an administrator. HRider assigns a random initial password; change it with the Change Password operation.

createEmployee.description: Create an employee. Provide the required `code`, `email`, `firstName`, and `lastName` fields.

createPosition.description: Create a job position in a department.

deleteClients.description: Remove client assignments from an employee using a `text/uri-list`.

deleteEmployee.description: Archive an employee by default. Set `archive` to `false` to delete the employee; archived records keep their history and no longer use a company license.

deleteEmployees.description: Unassign one or more employees from a job position using a `text/uri-list`.

deletePosition_1.description: Unassign the job position from an employee.

deleteSubordinates.description: Remove subordinate assignments from an employee using a `text/uri-list`.

getAdministrators.description: List account administrators. Use `companyId` to return only administrators assigned to that company.

getAdministrators_1.description: List administrators assigned to a company.

getAppraisal.description: Retrieve an appraisal by company and appraisal ID.

getAppraisals.description: List appraisals for a company. Filter by page, name or code text, and start-date range.

getClients.description: List clients assigned to an employee.

getCompanies.description: List the companies assigned to an administrator.

getCompanies_1.description: List companies. Use `administratorId` to filter for companies assigned to an administrator.

getCompanyLogo.description: Retrieve a company's logo. Set `alt` to `media` or request an `image/*` response to return image content; otherwise, the response is a File resource.

getDepartments.description: List departments in a company. Set `parentId` to return its children; use `-1` for top-level departments.

getEmployeePhoto.description: Retrieve an employee photo. Set `alt` to `media` or request an `image/*` response to return image content; otherwise, the response is a File resource.

getEmployees.description: List employees assigned to a job position.

getEmployees_1.description: List employees in a company. Results are paginated; filter by supervisor, provider, position, or employee code.

getFeedbackActionPlanReport.description: Download the Action Plan report as CSV (default) or Excel. Set `Accept` to `text/csv` or `application/vnd.ms-excel`.

getFeedbackCommentsReport.description: Download the Feedback Comments and Open Questions report as CSV (default) or Excel. Set `Accept` to `text/csv` or `application/vnd.ms-excel`.

getFeedbackDatabaseResponses.description: Download each evaluator's responses for each evaluated employee and indicator in CSV format.

getFeedbackDetailReport.description: Download the Feedback Detail report as CSV (default) or Excel. Set `Accept` to `text/csv` or `application/vnd.ms-excel`.

getFeedbackGroupDetailReport.description: Download the Feedback Detail by Group report as CSV (default) or Excel. Set `Accept` to `text/csv` or `application/vnd.ms-excel`.

getFeedbackReport.description: Retrieve an employee's feedback report for an appraisal. Set `alt` or `Accept` to `application/pdf` for a PDF; otherwise, the response is a File resource.

getFeedbackReports.description: List feedback reports for an appraisal.

getFeedbackReports_1.description: List feedback reports from an employee's history.

getFeedbackResultsAgeReport.description: Download feedback results by age as CSV (default) or Excel. Set `Accept` to `text/csv` or `application/vnd.ms-excel`.

getFeedbackResultsAntiquityReport.description: Download feedback results by length of service as CSV (default) or Excel. Set `Accept` to `text/csv` or `application/vnd.ms-excel`.

getFeedbackResultsGenderReport.description: Download feedback results by gender as CSV (default) or Excel. Set `Accept` to `text/csv` or `application/vnd.ms-excel`.

getFeedbackResultsJobsReport.displayName: Download Feedback Results by Job Position
getFeedbackResultsJobsReport.description: Download feedback results by job position as CSV (default) or Excel. Set `Accept` to `text/csv` or `application/vnd.ms-excel`.

getFeedbackResultsReport.description: Download feedback results as CSV (default) or Excel. Set `Accept` to `text/csv` or `application/vnd.ms-excel`.

getFile.description: Retrieve file metadata. Set `alt` to `media` or request an `image/*` response to return file content.

getInvitation.description: Retrieve an employee's invitation to an appraisal.

getNBoxResultsReport.description: Download the NBox results report as CSV (default) or Excel. Set `Accept` to `text/csv` or `application/vnd.ms-excel`.

getPosition.description: Retrieve a job position by ID.

getPosition_1.description: Retrieve the job position assigned to an employee.

getPositions.description: List job positions in a department.

getReports.description: List reports available for an appraisal. Available report types depend on the appraisal type and status.

getRoot.description: Use the API root to discover available resources and navigation links.

getSurveyListReport.description: Download the Surveys report as CSV (default) or Excel. Set `Accept` to `text/csv` or `application/vnd.ms-excel`.

getWorkingEnvAgeGenderReport.displayName: Download Working Environment Results by Age,Gender
getWorkingEnvAgeGenderReport.description: Download Working Environment results by age and gender as CSV (default) or Excel. Set `Accept` to `text/csv` or `application/vnd.ms-excel`.

getWorkingEnvAllReport.description: Download the full Working Environment report as an Excel workbook with separate sheets for department, position, age and gender, length of service, indicator groups, and indicators.

getWorkingEnvAntiquityReport.displayName: Download Working Environment Results by Tenure
getWorkingEnvAntiquityReport.description: Download Working Environment results by length of service as CSV (default) or Excel. Set `Accept` to `text/csv` or `application/vnd.ms-excel`.

getWorkingEnvDeptsReport.displayName: Download Working Environment Results by Department
getWorkingEnvDeptsReport.description: Download Working Environment results by department as CSV (default) or Excel. Set `Accept` to `text/csv` or `application/vnd.ms-excel`.

getWorkingEnvGroupsReport.displayName: Download Working Environment Results by Indicator
getWorkingEnvGroupsReport.description: Download Working Environment results by indicator group as CSV (default) or Excel. Set `Accept` to `text/csv` or `application/vnd.ms-excel`.

getWorkingEnvIndicatorsReport.displayName: Download Working Environment Results by Indicator
getWorkingEnvIndicatorsReport.description: Download Working Environment results by indicator as CSV (default) or Excel. Set `Accept` to `text/csv` or `application/vnd.ms-excel`.

getWorkingEnvJobsReport.displayName: Download Working Environment Results Job Position
getWorkingEnvJobsReport.description: Download Working Environment results by job position as CSV (default) or Excel. Set `Accept` to `text/csv` or `application/vnd.ms-excel`.

getWorkingEnvironmentFeedbackReport.description: Download the PDF report of Working Environment comments and open questions.

getWorkingEnvironmentReport.description: Download the PDF Working Environment report.

movePosition.description: Move a job position into the specified department using its ID or resource URI.

relateAdministrators.description: Assign one or more administrators to a company using a `text/uri-list`.

relateCompanies.description: Assign one or more companies to an administrator using a `text/uri-list`.

resendInvitation.description: Resend an appraisal invitation to an employee.

setClients.description: Assign clients to an employee using a `text/uri-list`.

setCompanyLogo.description: Upload a company logo as multipart form data. Include the image in the `data` part; the media type is read from `Content-Type` or the filename extension.

setEmployeePhoto.description: Upload an employee photo as multipart form data. Include the image in the `data` part; the media type is read from `Content-Type` or the filename extension.

setEmployees.description: Assign one or more employees to a job position using a `text/uri-list`.

setParent.description: Assign a parent department using its ID or resource URI in a `text/uri-list`.

setPosition.description: Assign a job position to an employee using its ID or resource URI in a `text/uri-list`.

setSubordinates.description: Assign subordinates to an employee using a `text/uri-list`.

setSupervisor.description: Assign a supervisor to an employee using its ID or resource URI in a `text/uri-list`.

unrelateAdministrators.description: Remove one or more administrator assignments from a company using a `text/uri-list`.

unrelateCompanies.description: Remove one or more company assignments from an administrator using a `text/uri-list`.
